description.value:
The Bakeneko is the oldest product in Tsunami’s current catalog, having been released among the earliest wave of tech weapons in the late 2040s. It’s not overly destructive, or engineered for extreme precision, but its electromag rails use an excessively dense capacitor array compared to modern standards. So, in the hands of the right shooter, this small, unassuming sidearm can be lethally vicious in the blink of an eye.

Cost: 850eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (3d6). This weapon’s Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action. Incompatible with Pistol Autosear.

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
